Hi Randi,

Two things I owe you an answer on, and one you should probably think about
before your next MassageBook bill.

STOP PAYING FOR THE PARTS WE CAN BUILD

You are currently paying a third party for the part of your business that
sits on your own website. That is worth questioning.

The booking calendar, gift certificates, packages, current offers,
reviews, the client sign-in - every one of those is something we can build
directly into reboundbodystudio.com. Not a widget borrowed
